data.body:
S6 completed and landed (Gerrit change 2003, merged as 21a178e276; LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 on patchset 2, full CI green on py3.11/3.12/3.13 ubuntu+macos). Evidence per AC:

AC1 (no retired policy sets / selection ladders / compat censuses / syntax tables / imperative grammars read or patched): the explicit intercept `if argv[0] == "<cmd>"` ladder was deleted from `_cli._main_dispatch`; the 13 duplicate literal policy frozensets (`_READS_INIT_ONLY`, `_WRITES_FULL`, `_BRIDGE`, `_HIDDEN_ALIASES`, ...) and the S2a shadow block were removed. The router now derives its four live sets from `_registry.derive_policy_sets()`. Proven by `test_dead_literal_policy_frozensets_are_gone`, `test_router_body_carries_no_explicit_intercept_ladder`, `test_router_uses_the_registry_derived_sets_as_its_sole_authority`.

AC2 (exactly one registered runtime-used parser factory + generated help mapping per command; both generator --check pass on a second render): every intercept route (21) + `audit` now carries lazy handler + `argv` adapter + init policy, so all dispatch through the single `_execute.execute`. `gen_cli_help.py --check` and `gen_cli_reference.py --check` both exit 0 byte-identical (second render). Proven by `test_every_intercept_route_carries_executable_metadata`, `test_every_handler_reference_resolves`, `test_registry_validate_reports_no_findings`.

AC3 (whole-route/parser shadow comparison: no unapproved delta in identity/mount/init/argv/diagnostics/confirmation/output/streams/exit/aliases/capability): behavior preserved. Per-family subprocess E2E executes with identical exit/output; init policies unchanged (`test_route_init_policy_matches_pre_cutover_census`, identity conditional-init tests); confirmation/legacy-output sets derived unchanged; central-mount + bridge vocabulary tests green; both generators byte-identical (help/reference/argv unchanged).

AC4 (approved help/overview + execution/degradation contracts pass via real subprocess + production path after compat exports removed): held-out subprocess E2E per intercept family (reconcile/review-plan/enrich/config/verify-*/identity/audit) green, plus test_cli, test_central_mount_gate_ad9f, test_cli_argparse, test_help_overview_coverage; full CI suite green across the version matrix.

AC5 (module-size/complexity/lint/type gates pass; no mechanically-split file < 100 lines): `_cli/__init__.py` 340 LOC and `_registry.py` 754 LOC (<= 800); complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0 (one `stale` improvement as `_main_dispatch` shrank); make lint + make typecheck clean; no new source module created (only test files added).

AC6 (migration docs state completed contract + code/artifact rollback; no persisted format change): ADR 0100 §9 documents the expand/contract migration and code-only back-out ("after contraction, a code revert restores the old router"); docs/cli-reference.md regenerates byte-identically; zero ticket/event/bridge/binding storage-format or data changes (no store/schema code touched).

TDD: behavioral/contract tests were authored RED-first; the implementation subagent saw only the happy-path oracle (`tests/unit/test_cli_registry_cutover_s6.py`); the held-out adversarial unit + per-family E2E oracle validated GREEN afterward, with a teeth check (breaking an intercept handler drove the held-out E2E RED, then restored). One non-blocking LLM-Review advisory (a source-grep guard flagged as change-detector) was kept: ADV1 explicitly sanctions a source guard accompanying an observable test, and it accompanies the primary observable proof `test_every_intercept_spelling_reaches_the_executor`.
